policy: no-go until all mandatory release gates have independently reviewed evidence for the release candidate

gates.name: Âmbito, requisitos e natureza jurídica aprovados
gates.reason: 31 of 46 requirements Por validar; statutory status of member dues unresolved

gates.name: Conteúdo institucional, marca e imagens aprovados
gates.reason: No evidenced sign-off for public copy, logos or image rights

gates.name: Autorização por perfil, escola, projeto e objeto validada
gates.reason: No reviewed multi-role authenticated E2E test; school isolation not implemented

gates.name: Regras reais Firebase Firestore e Storage revistas
gates.reason: Emulator deny-all rules are NOT the remote production rules

gates.name: Cifragem de PII configurada e legados migrados
gates.reason: Encryption feature flags OFF by default; legacy PII still readable to application

gates.name: Finalidades, retenção, direitos e imagens de menores aprovados
gates.reason: No independent legal basis, retention/AIPD triage, guardian consent assurance

gates.name: Testes funcionais ponta-a-ponta e acessibilidade aprovados
gates.reason: 15 of 55 test cases have passing automated execution links; no accepted independent review

gates.name: Cadeia de rastreabilidade completa e validada
gates.reason: No fully accepted requirement-to-production evidence chain

gates.name: Restauro, RPO/RTO, gestão de incidentes ensaiados
gates.reason: No executed backup restore or incident-response evidence

gates.name: Contas, quotas, doações, fundos e stock conciliados
gates.reason: Monetary and material modules incomplete; finance acceptance and reversal workflows missing

gates.name: Deploy de produção corresponde ao SHA aprovado
gates.reason: Observed Vercel production SHA behind main; no release approval

gates.name: Main protegida por revisão e checks obrigatórios
Suporte, monitorização e formação de operadores
gates.reason: On-call roles, documentation and support runbook not accepted

gates.name: GO/NO-GO formal e evidência aceite por decisor
gates.reason: No human release decision or accepted evidence
